pcb_method.description: Monthly Tax Deduction (MTD/PCB) is calculated using the Computerised Calculation Method as specified by LHDN. The formula considers annualised income, reliefs, and prior months' deductions.
key_points: PCB = (Estimated annual tax - Previous months' PCB) / Remaining months
Annual income = Current month salary x 12 + annualised allowances
Reliefs are deducted from annual income before tax calculation
EPF deduction capped at RM7,000 per year for PCB calculation
MTD applies to all employees earning above the threshold
Employers must use e-CP39 for PCB submission since March 2019
pcb_method.reference: LHDN Specification for Monthly Tax Deduction (MTD) 2026 — Computerised Calculation Method

notes: PCB tables are now electronic-only via e-CP39 system (since March 2019)
The specification PDF contains the full calculation algorithm
Employers should use LHDN's official calculator or approved payroll software
Tax brackets and reliefs are subject to annual budget changes
This data is for reference — always verify with LHDN for authoritative rates
